messages:
Priya: Idea: instead of a full handoff, try a split+shadow approach for resident-write validation. Route 95% normal, 5% shadow to resident region (non-committal) and compare diffs. low blast and gives us write-path visibility. Thoughts? :bulb:

Connor: Love it. Shadow writes are nice because they don't change live state. We need deterministic idempotency keys though so shadow vs real aren't ambiguous in logs.

Jules: Important: ensure GDPR/consent headers are applied to shadow copies too, or strip PII before sending to resident. Otherwise audit fails.

Priya: Agreed. Plan sketch: 1) add proxy splitter rule `split-shadow-v1` 2) shadow writes use header X-Shadow-To: eu-resident-1 and X-Shadow-Mode: dry-run 3) shadow payloads hashed for PII review.

Nina: Telemetry to capture: shadow_consistency_mismatch, shadow_failed_rate, shadow_latency_delta_p95, cross_region_write_volume. Also log sample request bodies (sanitized) for triage.

Connor: Small config example for proxy rule (pseudo-yaml):
```yaml
- name: split-shadow-v1
  match: tenant == "t-88*"
  split: 
    - weight: 95
      route: primary
    - weight: 5
      route: shadow-eu
  headers:
    - set: X-Shadow-Mode: dry-run
    - set: X-Policy-Id: split-shadow-v1
```

Jules: Ops constraint: disable prefix KV caching for shadow requests, otherwise you'll always see green because cache hides writes. Nina: can we tag cache metrics by `policy_id`?

Nina: Yes, we'll emit kv.cache_hits{policy_id=...}. I'll add that to the canary dashboard.

Priya: Roll sequence: apply splitter in staging, run 5k synthetic requests, compare shadow vs primary diffs, then enable on 1% prod traffic for 4 hours, watch metrics, then 5% and so on. Auto rollback if mismatch > 0.1% for 10m.

Connor: How do we define mismatch? If shadow response.status != primary.status OR normalized output token set differs by > X. We should use deterministic comparator lib so flakiness doesn't trigger false positives.

Jules: Also add a guard: if shadow_latency_delta_p95 > 350ms AND shadow_failed_rate > 0.2% simultaneously, trip the circuit and stop shadow routing. We don't want shadow to cause overloads.

runbot: Canary deploy scheduled: proxy/split-shadow-v1 -> cluster-canary-7 (job: 90214). Dashboard: https://obs.local/canary/90214

Nina: Who will own the first rollback decision? I can page eng-oncall and hold the revert button if metrics look bad. Priya: assign primary rollback to Connor, secondary to Jules.

Priya: One more: privacy audit. For EU tenants we must include X-Consent-Token and create a retention TTL on shadow logs = 7d. arch-note: update RFC-223 appendix for shadow logs.

Connor: For postmortem, collect `request_id`, `policy_id`, `shadow_decision` and the comparator score. We'll add a small query to spot systemic mismatches across tenants.

Jules: If this works, follow-up RFC: expose a safe "shadow-mode" toggle in the control plane so CS can request residency validation without infra PRs. But let's ship the canary first.

Priya: Sounds good. I'll open the PR with the splitter rule and attach the dashboard. Will ping here when canary is live. :white_check_mark:
